finding: The first comparison used SVO's standalone initialization tracker, not the map-tracking frontend shown in SVO demonstrations. The initial adapter also treated SVO edgelets as isotropic point observations and inherited an unnecessarily coarse EuRoC convergence configuration.

full_svo_map_frontend.decision: Reject this map-to-flow adapter. Homography initialization matches the planar scene but map loss still creates unacceptable gaps and loop error.

interpretation: The corrected standalone SVO tracker is close to KLT on identical support, covers 21 additional half-second windows, and closes the anchored loop better.
It does not yet beat KLT's common-window median error, so the claim that SVO is more accurate is not established.

The full SVO map frontend from rl_vo is not a drop-in optical-flow backend. Its demonstration strength is pose estimation with a persistent map; converting only adjacent map associations back into flow discards that benefit while inheriting map initialization and reset gaps.
The next flight-backend gate is ARM timing on the CM5 under representative capture load.
decision: Advance the corrected standalone SVO tracker to a selectable CM5 live-backend benchmark. Retain KLT only as the offline accuracy reference; do not advance the full map-to-flow adapter.
